summary: Dual-band IEEE 802.15.4g/SUN transceiver: sub-1GHz (389.5-510 / 779-1020 MHz) and 2.4 GHz radios with MR-FSK/MR-OFDM/MR-O-QPSK basebands, plus an LVDS I/Q interface; SPI slave with IRQ and RSTN; 26 MHz crystal (CL 8 pF) or TCXO; 1.8-3.6 V with internal 1.8 V regulators needing 100 nF each. Both RF ports are 50 ohm DIFFERENTIAL (RFP/RFN): the baluns/matching to a single-ended antenna are NOT in the datasheet or this entry, so node:rf09 / node:rf24 are not fab-ready. Bench stock at LCSC is low
